Move `import numpy as np` from inside the loop (line 96) to the top of the file with other imports.
boost() calls self.expand() which returns neighbors, but expand() uses self._lock causing deadlock since boost() already holds the lock. Also need to track already-boosted nodes.
Cluster algorithm only adds to first matching cluster. If A-B in cluster1 and B-C in cluster2, they won't merge. Implement union-find or merge all affected clusters.
Add try/finally for scheduler.shutdown() in server.py main(). http_server.py already has lifespan context manager but scheduler isn't stopped there either.
Generate tools list from TOOL_SCHEMAS instead of hardcoding.
Wrap float(importance) and float(completion) in try-except to return error instead of crash.
Change FTS search_fts failure from warning to error level. Also log in retrieve.py when falling back to low threshold.
Add try-except around _flush() JSON serialization to prevent data loss.
Add db.get_embeddings_batch() to avoid N+1 queries. Log warning when embeddings are missing.
Validate env var values, log warning and use default if invalid.
Replace os.popen("which engram") with shutil.which("engram"). Also fix graph.pkl reference → graph.json.
Add signal handler in http_server.py to flush graph on SIGTERM.
Bump version in __init__.py and pyproject.toml. Run full test suite.

Replace N+1 get_by_id calls with get_by_ids_batch for graph expansion neighbors
Reduce disk I/O by throttling flush to every 2s instead of every operation. Add atexit handler.
Add metadata parameter to update(), add batch ID retrieval, add embedding dimension validation
Wrap all embed() calls in try-except, add user_id format validation helper
Add lo/hi clamp to _float/_int so invalid env values can't break thresholds
Replace O(N²) Python combinations() with numpy matrix multiply for pairwise similarity
